name: Kiiroo Keon
summary: Cordless, ergonomic linear stroker paired with Kiiroo's FeelMe AI video-sync catalog, cam sites, and Pearl/PowerBlow partner toys.
ranking_rationale: Best grab-and-go cordless interactive stroker with sleek enclosure styling and built-in Kiiroo partner sync, though slower peak speed and pricier proprietary sleeves trail The Handy for VR power users.

pricing.notes: Check official Kiiroo store for current pricing; interactive FeelMe video plans sold separately.

pros: Cordless battery operation lets you use it anywhere without wall cables
Refined grip housing hides mechanical rail and accepts Kiiroo Feel sleeves
cons: Heavier in hand than basic sleeves and noticeably bulkier than The Handy track alone
Proprietary Feel sleeve refills cost more than generic open sleeves
Slower max stroke speed than wired linear rails

image.alt: Kiiroo Keon logo and brand card

facts.value: Rechargeable internal battery (~3–4 hours USB charging)
Syncs with Kiiroo Pearl2/Feel partners, SexLikeReal, and cam platforms
